checks.method: Exercise malformed input and retained-byte drift.
checks.observed: Duplicate YAML keys fail loudly. A changed raw observation, changed retained output, or changed source byte causes check mode to fail.

checks.observed: The scanner imports no LinkML, linkml-runtime, Malleus production module, or regular-expression engine and names neither SchemaView nor OntologyRegistry.

checks.method: Run the focused tests, offline check command, scoped Ruff, diff check, and verification-report byte validator.
checks.observed: All 11 focused tests passed. The retained scan matched fresh canonical bytes; scoped Ruff, diff check, and evidence-byte validation passed.

limitations: CC-X02 is raw measurement only. It does not resolve imports, merge declarations, compare definitions, select a winner, authorize adoption, or close OD-002.
The observation covers only the six ontology YAML files currently declared as wheel shared data. Any pyproject or source-byte change requires a fresh retained scan.
YAML is decoded with the configured PyYAML SafeLoader plus duplicate-key refusal. Source hashes bind these observations; cross-version YAML parser equivalence is not claimed.
Literal imports are retained but never opened. Built-in LinkML declarations and declarations outside the six packaged modules are not part of this measurement.
